title: RecipientIdentifier: no documented path from x509 cert to matches_recipient impl
description: The new owned RecipientIdentifier type is a public type that DecryptionKey implementors must handle in matches_recipient(). The conversion from the cms crate's type is done by private cms_rid_to_owned() in decrypt.rs. The public type doc does not explain: what issuer_der represents (DER RDN sequence), how serial bytes compare to x509_cert serial_number(), or how to correctly implement the match against a Certificate. Maintenance consequence: implementors will write subtly wrong comparisons that cause silent NoMatchingRecipient failures.
